name: Highways
overview: Scripture portrays highways both literally and figuratively as paths prepared by God for His people. Isaiah 40 calls for making straight a highway in the desert for the Lord, symbolizing the removal of obstacles to His coming, while Isaiah 35 describes this highway as the way of holiness, a secure path for the faithful. Proverbs 16 highlights the highway of the upright as departing from evil to preserve the soul, emphasizing the moral dimension of this path. Matthew 3 echoes the call to prepare and straighten the Lord's way, pointing to Christ as the fulfillment of these prophetic highways.
